script:
set -e
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/build/operator/.local/bin:$PATH
cd /build/initial
export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=/build/operator/.espressif/python_env/idf6.1_py3.12_env
source /build/operator/esp/esp-idf-s31/export.sh
export KORVO_SDK_PATH=/build/operator/esp/esp-dev-kits-s31
cd firmware/korvo-monitor
idf.py --preview -B /build/initial/isolated-korvo-build build
log_hash_scope: log_sha256 identifies original log before documented path/ANSI normalization
